assumptions_warnings: eGFR, serum creatinine and potassium are not provided – required before starting metformin and for ACE‑I monitoring (NICE NG203).
HbA1c / fasting glucose not available – needed to confirm pre‑diabetes status and to set glycaemic targets (NICE NG28).
Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio (ACR) unknown – needed to assess CKD severity and SGLT2‑inhibitor eligibility (NG203).
Smoking status not recorded – smoking cessation is a core recommendation for metabolic syndrome (CG181).
No documented allergy history – assumed no contraindication to statin, metformin, semaglutide or amlodipine.
Weight‑loss programme referral (NICE PH38) pending; patient must be enrolled in NHS Diabetes Prevention Programme.
treatment_summary: The plan addresses each component of the metabolic syndrome per NICE CG181/PH46/NG28: a high‑intensity statin (atorvastatin) for dyslipidaemia, metformin MR for pre‑diabetes (contingent on adequate renal function), semaglutide for obesity‑related weight loss and additional glycaemic benefit, and amlodipine as a conditional add‑on if blood pressure remains above target on lisinopril alone. Existing ACE‑I and COPD inhalers are continued. Monitoring of renal function, lipids, HbA1c, blood pressure, weight and potential drug interactions is outlined, and lifestyle interventions including referral to the Diabetes Prevention Programme are recommended.
